Beneficiary Dashboard — Final Pass, Round Two

7 Oct 2026. Part 1 is built: the richer Department card you approved, every card clickable, View Dashboard aligned. Part 2 is still for your decision. Wording rule applied throughout: titles and labels taken from the live site stay exactly as published; only words we wrote are touched. P8 (renaming “Type of Applicant”) is withdrawn: it is the same filter’s name on the DBIM design’s Schemes and Services page, and the two should match.

P10 · The Department page stops telling each trend twiceProposal

P11 · Motion, per the Apple guidanceProposal
